post.summary: Refresh the session
post.description:
Spends the refresh token and returns a new access token and a new refresh token.

Each refresh token works once. Presenting one that was already rotated is treated as theft:
the whole session is revoked, including the newest token. Clients must therefore serialize
refresh calls: of two concurrent calls with the same token, one succeeds and the other one
ends the session.

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_refresh_token: unknown, expired, revoked or reused refresh token, or the account is suspended.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this client; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

post.summary: Log out
post.description:
Revokes the session the refresh token belongs to. No bearer token is needed.

Always 204, so the endpoint cannot be used to test tokens. The access token is not revoked
on the server: it stops working when it expires (`expires_in`).

204.description: Always, whether the token was valid, unknown, expired or revoked.

422.description: The request is invalid.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this client; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

get.description:
The caller's own account, with the ID card fields (#250): the public code, the home
city and state, the ID photo as a signed URL and the member-since date.

422.description: The request is invalid.

patch.description:
Sets the caller's own first and last name (#165), home city and state and ID photo
(#250). Both names are required together while they are not stored; afterwards either may
change alone. The city and the state are set together, or both cleared with null. The
photo is the caller's own profile_photo upload key; for a pro without a public profile
photo it becomes that photo too. Nothing changes when any field is refused.

422.description: validation_error: an invalid or null name, an unknown field, an empty body, one name while the other is not stored yet, or home_city without home_state (or the other way round). invalid_media: photo_key is not the caller's own profile_photo upload.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired access token.

post.summary: Send a phone verification code
post.description:
Sends a verification code by SMS to the number, for the signed-in user.

Always 202 for a valid number, including one already verified by another account (then
nothing is sent). The SMS provider is called after the response, so neither the answer,
its timing nor a provider error tells whether a number is taken; a code that never
arrives surfaces at verify as invalid_code.

202.description: Accepted; a code is on its way by SMS.

422.description: validation_error: not an E.164 number, or a country code that is not allowed.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired access token.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this client; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

post.summary: Verify the phone with the code
post.description: Checks the code and stores the number as the user's verified phone (idempotent).

409.description: phone_unavailable: the number is another account's.

post.summary: Ask for a password reset code
post.description:
Emails a 6-digit reset code to the account with this email, if it exists and is active.

Always 202 with no body. The account lookup and the email happen after the response, so
neither the answer nor its timing tells whether the email has an account. A new request
replaces the previous code; a code that never arrives surfaces at reset as invalid_code.

202.description: Always, whether or not an account has this email.

422.description: validation_error: not an email address.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this client; retry later.

post.summary: Reset the password with the code
post.description:
Sets a new password with the emailed code. No bearer token is needed.

The code works once. A success revokes every refresh token of the account, so every
session must log in again; access tokens already issued stop working when they expire.

204.description: The password changed; all sessions ended.

422.description: validation_error: invalid email, a code that is not 6 digits, or password length.

400.description: invalid_code: no code, expired, wrong, already used or out of tries, or no active account with this email.

`key` to attach the file to a request, job or profile.

Stripe needs to pay them out. The first call creates the pro's payout account (one per pro,

or the link has expired; then read GET /v1/pros/me/payouts.

post.summary: Send a quote for one of my opportunities
post.description:
A fixed-price quote: the price in cents, what it includes, optionally how the pro will
do the job, the estimated duration and a proposed start. It expires after the platform's
quote lifetime. The first quote on a request makes it Quote Ready for the customer. The
response shows the pro what they will receive: the price minus the platform's fee.

422.description: validation_error: amount or duration not a positive integer or above the platform's cap, scope empty or too long, approach too long or with a NUL character, proposed_start_at not a future time with a time zone, or a field the server sets (status, expires_at, pro or request).

403.description: forbidden: only pros send quotes.

404.description: not_found: no opportunity of the caller with this id.

503.description: not_configured: quoting is not configured yet (the quote lifetime is not set, or a quote cap or the platform's take rate is set to an invalid value).

The quotes the customer can choose from: the pending ones not yet expired, and the
accepted one while the payment is pending. Empty until the request is Quote Ready, and
once it is closed. Each shows the price, what it includes and how the pro will do the job
(contact details masked), the duration, the proposed start, when it expires, and the pro's
public card.

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers have service requests.

404.description: not_found: no request of the caller with this id.

The pro behind one of the quotes the customer can choose from, as the comparison list
shows them, plus their bio (contact details masked), their active categories and the month
they joined. Available exactly while the list shows the quote. Never a contact, a document,
the photo, the service areas or payout details: contacts stay hidden before payment.

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers see the pros who quoted.

post.summary: Accept a quote on one of my service requests
post.description:
Accepts one quote of the request: the quote becomes accepted and the request moves to
accepted, where the payment follows; the other quotes stay pending. Calling it again for the
accepted quote returns it unchanged, and changes nothing, even if its pro can no longer be
hired: that repeat comes first, then a new acceptance checks the pro (approved, payouts
enabled). The response is the quote as listed, its scope and approach masked; its pro card
shows the pro's current verification.

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers accept quotes.

404.description: not_found: no request of the caller with this id, or no quote with this id on it.

409.description: quote_not_acceptable, for a new acceptance only: its pro can no longer be hired; the request already accepted another quote or is not Quote Ready; or the quote was rejected, withdrawn or expired, or is past its expires_at.

post.summary: Pay for the quote I accepted
post.description:
What the Payment Sheet needs to charge the customer for the quote they accepted: the
PaymentIntent's client secret, the customer and an ephemeral key for it, the publishable
key, and the amount, the tax and the total shown before paying. The amounts are the
accepted quote's, computed on the server; the body takes no field. The first call creates
the PaymentIntent; later calls return the same one (a new ephemeral key each time), until
the payment succeeds (then the job exists: 409). The pro is checked again on every call:
one who can no longer be hired is a 409, and nothing is created.

422.description: validation_error: a malformed id, or a field in the body: the amounts come from the accepted quote, never from the client.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers pay for quotes.

404.description: not_found: no request of the caller with this id, or no quote with this id on it.

409.description: payment_not_available: the request is not accepted or this quote is not its accepted one, or the payment already succeeded (the job exists or is being created) or its PaymentIntent is closed; pro_not_hireable: the quote's pro can no longer be hired (not approved, or payouts disabled). Nothing was created. payment_needs_review: an earlier PaymentIntent create never answered and Stripe may have forgotten it; support resolves the payment before another is created.

502.description: payments_error: Stripe refused the call; nothing changed, the payment can be asked for again.

503.description: not_configured: payments are not configured; payments_unavailable: Stripe is not reachable or asked to retry later; nothing changed, retry later.

post.description:
Asks to be told when the ZIP is served. No sign-in needed (a web visitor can join); with
a valid bearer token the entry is linked to the account. The contact is used only for that
notice. Joining twice with the same contact and ZIP refreshes the entry.

202.description: On the list; the same answer whether the contact already was.

422.description: invalid_category: unknown or inactive category; validation_error: no email or phone, a bad ZIP, email or phone, or a phone outside the allowed country codes.

409.description: zip_served: the ZIP is served; create a request.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

post.summary: Receive a Stripe event
post.description:
Stripe's only entry point. No access token: the Stripe-Signature HMAC over the raw body
is the credential. Each event is stored once by its id and handled by the worker; a
duplicate delivery answers 200 too. Any non-2xx makes Stripe deliver the event again.

422.description: The request is invalid.

400.description: invalid_signature: Stripe-Signature is missing, does not match the body or is too old; invalid_payload: the signed body is not a Stripe event.

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is too large.

500.description: internal_error: the event could not be stored or queued; Stripe delivers it again.

503.description: not_configured: the signing secret is not set; Stripe delivers it again.

requestBody.description: The event exactly as Stripe sent it; the signature covers these bytes.

get.description:
The caller's address book: the default first, then the oldest first. `served` tells
whether the ZIP has an active service area; when it does not, offer the waitlist.

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers keep saved addresses.

post.summary: Save an address
post.description:
Adds an address to the caller's book. The first one is the default; `is_default` makes
the new one the default instead. An unserved ZIP is saved too, with `served` false.

422.description: validation_error: a label empty, longer than 30 characters, with a control or format character or a contact detail; an address field out of format; lat or lng alone or out of range.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers keep saved addresses.

409.description: address_limit_reached: the caller already keeps the most addresses allowed; address_label_taken: the caller already has an address with this label, ignoring case.

429.description: rate_limited: too many saved-address writes; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

patch.description:
Changes any subset of the fields of one of the caller's addresses. `is_default: true`
moves the default here. A request created from this address keeps its own copy.

422.description: validation_error: a label empty, longer than 30 characters, with a control or format character or a contact detail; an address field out of format; lat or lng alone or out of range; is_default false (make another address the default instead); a required field null; an address_id that is not a UUID.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers keep saved addresses.

404.description: address_not_found: no saved address of the caller with this id (another user's id answers the same).

409.description: address_label_taken: the caller already has an address with this label, ignoring case.

429.description: rate_limited: too many saved-address writes; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

delete.description: Removes one of the caller's addresses. Requests created from it are not affected.

204.description: Deleted. If it was the default, the oldest remaining address is.

422.description: validation_error: an address_id that is not a UUID.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

403.description: forbidden: only customers keep saved addresses.

404.description: address_not_found: no saved address of the caller with this id (another user's id answers the same).

429.description: rate_limited: too many saved-address writes; retry later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current limit window ends.

get.description:
Every group with each of its channels: `enabled` is the caller's choice, or the default
when they never changed it. A `locked` channel is always on (account and security).

422.description: The request is invalid.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

patch.description:
Applies the changes all or nothing and returns every preference, as GET does. Turning a
locked channel on is accepted and changes nothing. Pushes muted while a group was off are
not sent when it is turned back on.

422.description: preference_locked: a change turns off a locked channel; validation_error: an unknown group or channel, a channel its group does not have, a group and channel twice, no change or more than 20. Either way nothing is stored.

401.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired token.

receipt.description: On the caller's own messages (sender me): seen once the other side marked it read, delivered once their app fetched it (a page of the chat returned it), sent before that. Null on the other side's messages. A push notification does not count as delivered.

warning.description: contact_details_hidden when something in the text was masked (redacted is true): the app tells the sender that contact details are not shared in the chat. Null otherwise.

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

original.title: Original
original.description: What the sender typed, for a redacted message whose original is still kept (encrypted, for CHAT_ORIGINAL_RETENTION_DAYS); null otherwise, or when it cannot be read. Every response that carries one is audited.

receipt.description: How far the message got with the other side (the one who did not send it): seen, delivered or sent, as its sender sees it.

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: An allowed MIME type, e.g. image/jpeg.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file; it is signed into the URL.

key.title: Key
key.description: Where the file will live; features store it.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT, or the storage rejects it.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164, set once verified by SMS code.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Null for accounts created before names.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Null for accounts created before names.

public_code.title: Public Code
public_code.description: The ID card's code: 8 Crockford base32 characters (0-9, A-Z without I, L, O, U), fixed at sign-up. Shown grouped as XXXX-XXXX.

home_state.title: Home State
home_state.description: A US state or DC code, e.g. FL; null until set.

photo.description: The ID photo, a presigned GET; null until set.

member_since.title: Member Since
member_since.description: The day (UTC) the account was created.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description:
The user as the API shows it. Never carries the password hash; the ID photo comes as
a signed URL (#250).

UtmIn.title: UtmIn
UtmIn.description: Campaign attribution. Only these five keys; anything else is a 422.

phone.description: E.164, with an allowed country code.

WebhookReceived.title: WebhookReceived
WebhookReceived.description: Stripe reads only the status code; the body says the event is safely stored.
